parameters.text:
=You are an email-based meeting booker for Citta Capital.

Inputs:
- Sender: Shane Wilson
- Recipient first name: {{ $json.first_name }}
- Company: {{ $json.company_name }}
- About: {{ $json.About }}
- Channel: {{ $json.channel }}

Task: Generate TWO short personalization fields.

Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys:
{
  "email": "string",
  "linkedin": "string"
}

RULES FOR "email" (used when channel includes email):
- 1–2 sentences, sentence-ready, inserted after: "I wanted to get in touch with {{ $json.company_name }}."
- Use ONLY information from the About field.
- If About is vague or empty: return exactly "Your work in this space stood out to us."
- Do NOT invent metrics, customers, or details not stated.

RULES FOR "linkedin" (used when channel includes linkedin):
- 1–4 words, neutral industry/function only (e.g. "autonomous freight", "energy management").
- No adjectives, no claims, no buzzwords.
- HARD LIMIT: 30 characters or fewer.
- Use ONLY information from the About field.
- If unclear: return exactly "your sector"

If channel is "linkedin_only": return email as empty string "".
If channel is "email_only": return linkedin as empty string "".

No markdown. No commentary. JSON only.

options.systemMessage: You are a personalization function. Output valid JSON only. Never fabricate. Use only information explicitly provided. Return defaults when unsure.

_readme: CREDENTIAL UPDATES REQUIRED AFTER IMPORT:
- All Google Sheets nodes: use 'March2026_Refactor_Prospector' credential
- Create Tab If Not Exists HTTP Request: same Google Sheets OAuth2 credential
- OpenAI Chat Model: update if needed
SOURCE SHEET SCHEMA (AutoAdded_postMar2026):
Pitchbook | company_name | Url | first_name | Email | Founder Linkedin | About | Date Added | Contacted
NOTE: column names are NOT canonical — Coalesce & Normalize handles renaming.
DO NOT rename sheet columns — the workflow is designed to work with them as-is.
DESTINATION SHEET (Woodpecker campaign loader, Sheet1):
pitchbook_url | company_name | website_url | first_name | email | linkedin_url |
about | date_added | channel | personalized_email | personalized_linkedin
KEY ARCHITECTURE — DATA PRESERVATION PATTERN:
The n8n AI Agent node replaces the item with {output:'...'} only.
Each branch uses a 'Preserve Data' merge node (combineByPosition):
- input 0: AI agent output {output:'...'}
- input 1: original item (direct copy from Route by Channel)
The merge zips them so Parse receives both AI output AND all prospect fields.
KEY CHANGES FROM PREVIOUS VERSION:
- Assign Channel now uses actual sheet column names: Email, 'Founder Linkedin'
- AI prompts now use $json.About (capital A, actual sheet column name)
- Added Preserve Data merge nodes for ALL three branches (was only email_only)
- Removed spurious 'Merge' node that combined linkedin_only + email_only parse results
- Rejoin Contactable Channels changed to Append mode (was combineByPosition)
- Get Uncontacted Leads filter now uses 'Contacted' (actual column name)
- Mark Contacted matches by 'Pitchbook', writes to 'Contacted' (actual column names)
- Append to Campaign Tab destination: Woodpecker loader Sheet1 (full column set)
